title: Sidecar and MCP build venvs are created with whatever `python3` is on PATH; Homebrew moved python3 to 3.14 mid-run (batch 5 built on 3.14, batch 4 on 3.13) so the shipped binaries' interpreter is not pinned to the 3.13 the stack declares
repro: `python3 --version` on the build machine → 3.14; `node scripts/ensure-all-sidecars.mjs --force` builds every sidecar with it; nothing in scripts/ or CI asserts the interpreter version.
fix_shape: Resolve the interpreter explicitly in scripts/ensure-*.mjs and sidecar-staleness (prefer `python3.13`, else fail with a named message; env override VYSTED_PYTHON); assert sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 13) at build time; document in the release runbook; prove with a clean build in the next verifier.
